sanskrit: antakāya mṛtyave nama iha- -ayam astu puruṣaḥ sahāsunā | sūryasya bhāge amṛtasya loke prāṇā apānā iha te ramantām ||
english: Homage to Antaka, to Mṛtyu — let this man remain here together with his vital breath. In the portion of Sūrya, in the realm of immortality, may your in-breath and out-breath take their delight here.

sanskrit: ud enaṃ bhago agrabhīd ud enaṃ somo aṃśumān | ud enaṃ maruto devā ud indrāgnī svastaye ||
english: Bhaga has seized him upward, the radiant Soma has seized him upward; the Maruts, the gods, have raised him up — Indra and Agni have raised him for well-being.

sanskrit: iha te 'sur iha prāṇa ihāyur iha te manaḥ | ut tvā nirṛtyāḥ pāśebhyo daivyā vācā bharāmasi ||
english: Here is your vital force, here your breath, here your life-span, here your mind. With the divine word we bear you up out of the nooses of Nirṛti.

sanskrit: ut krāmāto māva patthā mṛtyoḥ paḍvīśam avamuñcamānaḥ | mā cchitthā asmāl lokād agneḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśaḥ ||
english: Rise up and do not fall down; loosening the foot-fetter of Death, do not sever yourself from this world, from the sight of Agni and Sūrya.

sanskrit: tubhyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ mātariśvā tubhyaṃ varṣantv amṛtāny āpaḥ | sūryas te tanve śaṃ tapāt tvāṃ mṛtyur dayatāṃ mā pra meṣṭhāḥ ||
english: May Vāyu, Mātariśvan, blow for you; may the waters rain down their immortal gifts upon you; may Sūrya warm your body with well-being. Let Death be compassionate toward you — do not perish.

sanskrit: udyānaṃ te puruṣa nāvayānaṃ jīvātaṃ te dakṣatātiṃ kṛṇotu | ā hi rohemam amṛtaṃ sukhaṃ ratham atha jirvir vidatham ā vadāsi ||
english: Your going is upward, O man, not a going-down; may your living make your vitality complete. Mount this immortal, pleasant chariot, and then in old age speak forth at the assembly.

sanskrit: mā te manas tatra gān mā tiro bhūn mā jīvebhyaḥ pra mado mānu gāḥ pitṝn | viśve devā abhi rakṣantu tveha ||
english: Let not your mind go thither; let it not be lost. Do not stray from the living in intoxication; do not follow the Pitṛs. May all the gods protect you here.

sanskrit: mā gatānām ā dīdhīthā ye nayanti parāvatam | ud ā roha tamaso jyotir ehy ā te hastaṃ rabhāmahe
english: Do not fix your gaze upon those who have gone, those who lead to the far realm. Ascend, come from darkness to light — we take hold of your hand.

sanskrit: śyāmaś ca tvā śabalaś ca preṣitau yamasya yau pathirakṣī śvānau | arvāṅ ehi mā vi dīdhyo māti tiṣṭhaḥ parāṅmanāḥ ||
english: Śyāma and Śabala, the two dogs of Yama, the road-guardians sent forth — come hither; do not stare away, do not stand there with your mind turned backward.

sanskrit: maitaṃ panthām anu gā bhīma eṣa yena pūrvaṃ nayatha taṃ bravīmi | tama etat puruṣa mā pra patthā bhayaṃ parastād abhayaṃ te arvāk ||
english: Do not travel this path — it is dreadful, the one by which they lead those who went before; so I declare it. Darkness lies yonder, O man; do not fall forward upon it. Fear lies beyond, but safety lies this side of you.

sanskrit: rakṣantu tvāgnayo ye apsv antā rakṣatu tvā manuṣyā yam indhate | vaiśvānaro rakṣatu jātavedā divyas tvā mā pra dhāg vidyutā saha ||
english: May the fires that dwell within the waters guard you; may that fire which men kindle guard you. May Vaiśvānara, Jātavedas, guard you. May the heavenly one not scorch you along with the lightning.

sanskrit: rakṣatu tvā pṛthivī rakṣatu dyaus sūryaś ca tvā rakṣatāṃ candramāś ca | mā tvā kravyād abhi maṃsta- -ārāt saṃkasukāc cara ||
english: May Earth guard you, may Dyaus guard you; may Sūrya and Candramās guard you. Let the flesh-eater not assail you — keep away from Saṃkasuka from afar.

sanskrit: antarikṣaṃ rakṣatu devahetyā bodhaś ca tvā pratībodhaś ca rakṣatām | asvapnaś ca tvānavadrāṇaś ca rakṣatāṃ gopāyaṃś ca tvā rakṣatāṃ jāgṛviś ca ||
english: May the mid-air with its divine weapon guard you; may Awareness and Counter-awareness guard you. May the Sleepless One and the Ever-wakeful guard you; may the Watcher guard you, and the Vigilant.

sanskrit: te tvā rakṣantu te tvā gopāyantu te tvāṃhasas pāntu | tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā ||
english: Let them guard you, let them protect you, let them shield you from distress. Homage to them; svāhā to them.

sanskrit: jīvebhyas tvā samude vāyur indro dhātā dadhātu savitā trāyamāṇaḥ | mā tvā prāṇo balaṃ hāsīd asuṃ te 'nu hvayāmasi ||
english: For the living, in the community, may Vāyu, Indra, Dhātṛ, the protecting Savitṛ establish you. Let not the breath forsake your strength — we call after your vital spirit.

sanskrit: mā tvā jambhaḥ saṃhanur mā tamo vidan mā jihvā barhiḥ pramayuḥ kathā syāḥ | ut tvādityā vasavo bharantu- -ud indrāgnī svastaye ||
english: Let neither the jaw nor the snap of teeth find you; let not the darkness; let not the tongue of the sacrificial grass cause your destruction — how could you perish? May the Ādityas and Vasus raise you up; may Indra and Agni raise you for well-being.

sanskrit: ayaṃ devā ihaivāstv ayaṃ māmutra gād itaḥ | imaṃ sahasravīryeṇa mṛtyor ut pārayāmasi ||
english: O gods, let this man be here only; let him not go from here to yonder. We ferry this one across from Death with a thousandfold heroic power.

sanskrit: ut tvā mṛtyor apīparaṃ saṃ dhamantu vayodhasaḥ | mā tvā vyastakeśyo mā tvāgharudo rudan ||
english: I have ferried you across from Death; may the life-sustaining ones blow strength into you. Let not the disheveled-haired woman weep over you; let not she who wails with grief lament for you.

sanskrit: āhārṣaṃ tvāvidaṃ tvā punar āgāḥ punarṇavaḥ | sarvāṅga sarvaṃ te cakṣuḥ sarvam āyuś ca te 'vidam ||
english: I have fetched you back; I have found you. You have returned, renewed. With every limb intact, all your sight, and all your life-span I have found for you.

sanskrit: ut tvā dyaur ut pṛthivy ut prajāpatir agrabhīt | ut tvā mṛtyor oṣadhayaḥ | somarājñīr apīparan ||
english: Heaven has seized you upward, and Earth, and Prajāpati has seized you upward. The plants whose queen is Soma have ferried you across from Death.

sanskrit: yāvat te jyotir abhūd apa tvat tamo akramīt | apa tvan mṛtyuṃ nirṛtim apa yakṣmaṃ ni dadhmasi ||
english: As far as your light extended, darkness has retreated from you. Away from you we blow Death, Nirṛti, and wasting disease.

sanskrit: ā rabhasvemām amṛtasya śnuṣṭim acchidyamānā jaradaṣṭir astu te | asuṃ ta āyuḥ punar ā bharāmi rajas tamo mopa gā mā pra meṣṭhāḥ ||
english: Grasp hold of this hearing of immortality; may your old age be unbroken. I bring back your vital force and your life-span. Do not go to the dust, to darkness — do not perish.

sanskrit: jīvatāṃ jyotir abhy ehi lokam ā tvā harāmi śataśāradāya | drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ te kṛṇomy ava muñcantu mṛtyupāśā aśastīḥ ||
english: Come back to the light of the living, to the world; I carry you to a hundred autumns. I make your life-span ever longer and more extended. Let the nooses of Death, the curses, be released.

sanskrit: vātāt te prāṇam avidaṃ sūryāc cakṣur ahaṃ pari | yat te manas tvayi tad dhārayāmi saṃ vitsvāṅgair vada jihvayālapan ||
english: From Vāyu I have recovered your breath; from Sūrya I have recovered your sight all around. Whatever mind is yours, in you I hold it steady. Awaken with all your limbs; speak, converse with your tongue.

sanskrit: prāṇena tvāṃ dvipadāṃ catuṣpadām agnim iva jātam abhi saṃ dhamāmi | namas te mṛtyo cakṣuṣe namaḥ prāṇāya te 'karam ||
english: With the breath of bipeds and quadrupeds I blow upon you as upon a fire just kindled. Homage to your eye, O Mṛtyu; I have paid homage to your breath.

sanskrit: ayaṃ jīvatu mā mṛta- -imaṃ sam īrayāmasi | kṛṇomy asmai bheṣajaṃ mṛtyo mā puruṣaṃ vadhīḥ ||
english: Let this one live; let him not die — we stir this one back into life. I make the healing remedy for him. O Mṛtyu, do not slay this man.

sanskrit: jīvalāṃ naghāriṣāṃ jīvantīm oṣadhīm aham | trāyamāṇāṃ sahamānāṃ sahasvatīm arundhatīm iha huve 'smā ariṣṭatātaye ||
english: The Jīvalā, the Naghāriṣā, the living herb — the protecting, enduring, powerful Arundhatī — these I invoke here for his inviolate well-being.

sanskrit: adhi brūhi mā rabhathāḥ sṛjemaṃ tavaiva sant sarvahāyā ihāstu | bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ śarma yacchatam apasidhya duritaṃ dhattam āyuḥ ||
english: Speak favorably; do not seize him — release this one. Belonging to you entirely, let him who lives all his years be here. O Bhava and Śarva, show mercy, grant shelter; thrust evil away and bestow life.

sanskrit: devānāṃ hetiḥ pari tvā vṛṇaktu pārayāmi rajasa ut tvā mṛtyor apīparam | ārād agniṃ kravyādaṃ nirūhan jivātave te paridhiṃ dadhāmi ||
english: May the weapon of the gods enfold you protectively. I ferry you across; I have carried you over from the dust of Death. Driving the flesh-eating fire away from afar, I place a boundary around you for the sake of life.

sanskrit: asmai mṛtyo adhi brūhi- -imaṃ dayasvod ito 'yam etu | ariṣṭaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ suśruj jarasā śatahāyanātmanā bhujam aśnavat ||
english: O Mṛtyu, speak favorably for this one; be gracious to him — let him go up from here. Uninjured, with all his limbs intact, well-formed, let him attain the enjoyment of the self through old age for a hundred years.

sanskrit: yat te niyānaṃ rajasaṃ mṛtyo anavadhariṣyam | patha imaṃ tasmād rakṣanto brahmāsmai varma kṛṇmasi ||
english: O Mṛtyu, the dusty downward path of yours — I have turned it away from him. Guarding this man from that path, we make the brahman a coat of armor for him.
